queue_summary.note: Historical metadata queue only. No payload downloads performed. Includes unknown-scope candidates for acquisition, not approved training examples.

short_eof_behavior: Incomplete normal EOF and interrupted reads retain partial prefix, count received traffic, persist retry deadline, and resume with Range; completed checksum mismatch and oversize remain integrity_failed.
test_scope: Owned acquisition, official-access hold, append-only refreshed queue modules; separate progress reporting tests are not included in this count.
guestbook_behavior: Only the explicit Dataverse required-Guestbook JSON message becomes access_action_required; other HTTP 400 responses are not reclassified. Existing release holds validate official PID/version/file IDs.
append_queue_behavior: Immutable full-catalog snapshot and exact ID coverage; SQL authorizer rejects edits to existing downloads rows; file/version conflicts held per release; unresolved scope review is not acquisition or training approval.

subsequent_url_hostname_verification.note: Earlier 42-test result and its source hashes above are preserved as a historical observation; 51-test combined verification includes the two new hostname boundary tests and the separate trial-wrapper tests.
